title: hotify-cli: always deploy new binary to dk1 after any improvement
description:
After building hotify-cli locally (go build -o hotify-cli .), copy the binary to dk1 and restart its daemon:
1. scp -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa_srv -o IdentitiesOnly=yes hotify-cli dk1@92.113.145.178:~/hotify-cli/hotify-cli-new
2. ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa_srv dk1@92.113.145.178: pkill -f 'hotify-cli start'; cp ~/hotify-cli/hotify-cli-new ~/.local/bin/hotify-cli; nohup ~/.local/bin/hotify-cli start -port=8080 > ~/hotify-cli/hotify.log 2>&1 &
3. Token persists in ~/.hotify/api_keys.json — no need to re-register the remote unless that file is deleted.
WHY: dk1 runs hotify as the dk1 user on port 8080. Without redeployment it runs a stale binary. This caused the 'unreachable' bug on 2026-05-22 when the old binary (no key persistence) rotated its in-memory token on restart.
